answer: Proof of Stake achieves Sybil resistance by tying identity to capital, creating a deep canyon between honest nodes and attackers. An agent must stake native tokens to participate, ensuring the cost of creating a fake plume of identities outweighs potential block rewards. Each malicious echo of a false node drains the attacker’s collateral, as protocol rules slash assets for any detected fraudulent consensus behavior, effectively pricing out large-scale identity fabrication.
